scripts.preinstall: node -e "const path=require('node:path'); const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; const execPath=process.env.npm_execpath||''; const initCwd=process.env.INIT_CWD||''; const isRepoInstall=initCwd && path.resolve(initCwd)===process.cwd(); const blocked=ua.startsWith('npm/') || ua.startsWith('yarn/') || execPath.includes('npm-cli.js') || execPath.includes('yarn'); if (isRepoInstall && blocked) { console.error('This repository must be installed with pnpm. Run corepack enable and then pnpm install.'); process.exit(1); }"
